cards.card_text: The praise closes with "Amen and amen." Friend, I'm saying amen right along with it.

He closes by blessing the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting, tells all the people to say amen, and ends right where he started: "Hallelujah!" Go ahead, baker, say it, because mine comes out a little muffled through the mustache but it COUNTS.

cards.card_text: Between an Amen at the start and an Amen at the end, they say blessing, glory, wisdom, thanks, honor, power and strength be to our God forever and ever.
And all they say is "Amen, Hallelujah!" Friend, I have never said ANYTHING in two words in my whole life.

cards.card_text: After that promise comes "Amen" and then a short plea to the Lord Jesus.
cards.verse_text: He who testifies to these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen.
cards.snippet: He who testifies to these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen.

cards.card_text: That's how the whole Bible ends, friend: grace for all the saints, and then "Amen." I can't think of a better way to close the book.
